8.3.15 EthTrcv_ RunCableDiagnostic
[SWS_EthTrcv_91011] Definition of API function EthTrcv_RunCableDiagnostic ⌈
Service Name
EthTrcv_RunCableDiagnostic
Syntax
Std_ReturnType EthTrcv_RunCableDiagnostic (
uint8 TrcvIdx
)
Service ID [hex]
0x16
Sync/Async
Asynchronous
Reentrancy
Reentrant for different TrcvIdx. Non reentrant for the same TrcvIdx.
Parameters (in)
TrcvIdx
Index of the Ethernet transceiver within the context of the
Ethernet Transceiver Driver.
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
Std_ReturnType
E_OK: The trigger has been accepted.
E_NOT_OK: The trigger has not been accepted.
Description
Trigger the cable diagnostics for the given Ethernet transceiver.
Available via
EthTrcv.h
⌋
[SWS_EthTrcv_00170] ⌈The function shall be pre compile time configurable On/Off
by the configuration parameter EthTrcvEnableCableDiagnosticApi [ECUC_EthTrcv_-
00054].⌋
